note: Reference lists as a tenant would hold them under Detection > Lists. This trainer bundles them; in Google SecOps they are objects you create and maintain, and a query names them with %list_name.

lists.name: sponsor_domains

lists.name: admin_accounts

lists.name: blocked_ranges
lists.description: Ranges the gateway blocks after the first case.

lists.name: lookalike_patterns
lists.description: Shapes of lookalike domains seen against the station: a sponsor name with an extra word, or the station name with a hyphen.
